recommendations.scenario: Elective GI endoscopy, preserving diagnostic and high-risk intervention categories.
recommendations.interruption: Low risk: suggest continuation. High risk: CrCl >60: 1-2 days; 30-59: 3 days; 15-29: 4 days.
recommendations.resumption: Hemostasis- and procedure-dependent; no universal restart timestamp.
recommendations.renal: Table 7 bands >60, 30-59, 15-29 mL/min. Exactly 60, <15 and unstable renal function remain unresolved in the agent snapshot.
recommendations.exceptions: Verify indication, recent VTE/ACS/stent or stroke, concomitant antithrombotics, renal stability, hepatic dysfunction, planned intervention and hemostasis. Mechanical valves must not be treated as an apixaban indication.
recommendations.bridging: Preserve source-specific DOAC versus vitamin-K-antagonist distinctions. No bridging prescription is generated by this evidence package.

recommendations.scenario: Elective invasive procedures; risk definitions are source-specific.
recommendations.interruption: At least 48 elapsed hours for moderate/high bleeding risk; at least 24 for low risk/easily controlled noncritical bleeding.
recommendations.resumption: As soon as adequate hemostasis is established; not a fixed 24-hour restart rule.
recommendations.renal: Do not infer that the minimum elapsed-hour interval is sufficient in severe CKD; exact renal sections remain pending.
recommendations.exceptions: Verify indication, recent VTE/ACS/stent or stroke, concomitant antithrombotics, renal stability, hepatic dysfunction, planned intervention and hemostasis. Mechanical valves must not be treated as an apixaban indication.
